sentences.text: Shri Manu Maheshwari - advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Zishan Khan and Shri Noor Ahmed Sheikh, learned   the respondent [OBJ].
Shri Rishi Shrivastava, learned counsel for the respo  Shri Rahul Solanki Govt.
Advocate for the respondent/

ORDER This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to Crime No.23/2025 dated (not mentioned),
registered at Police Station- Padrinath, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 409,
420 of IPC, 1860.

The applicant is in custody since 05.03.2025.
2.

As per prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that of withdrawal of Rs.3,59,243/- from the bank account of mosque maintained with SBI, Chhawani Branch, Indore despite not being the authorised signatory or office bearer at the relevant time.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12376 2 MCRC-19166-2025 3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that allegation against the applicant is that of cheating and misappropriation of money (Rs.3,59,243/-) of Waqf Board.
Applicant is ready to deposit the aforesaid amount before releasing on bail.
Applicant is aged about 70 years and is in custody since 05.03.2025 (already completed custody of more than two months).
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Learned Govt. Advocate has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/complainant has opposed the prayer and submitted that applicant is an habitual offender and already one case is pending and in that case he has been arrested.
6. In reply, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that actually in the said offence applicant has been arrested and later on released on bail 7.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, applicant is ready to deposit the alleged amount, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.

Consequently without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed subject to deposit of Rs.3,59,243/-.
8 .

It is directed that the applicant/accused be released on bail subject NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:12376 3 MCRC-19166-2025 to depositing Rs.3,59,243/- and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
